findings.text: follow-on: the tests: line names only tests/test_contour_tree_scatter_equivalence.py, but the gate the brief set was six per-file commands and it is the six-command string that ran; promotion fills its gate receipt from this line (the baseline_suite/after_suite arms carry all six), so the receipt for this run understates the studied set until the line lists every command or names the aggregate.

item_verdicts.diff: read all three commits against base 3baa4796e; c0577f527 adds the four-vertex permutation regression to tests/test_contour_tree_wall_split.py, b074fcdd8 adds implicit_outside to the births branch of _sweep_tree, 8d4a53238 adds the evidence fragment, 45 insertions and 1 deletion total.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when is 'per-file pytest runs of the six contour-tree files named in the brief report 0 failure ids at head that are absent at base'; the twelve per-file arms are on disk, base-aggregate.log closes 44 passed and 4 failed and head-aggregate.log 48 passed and 0 failed, so the added-failure count is 0.
item_verdicts.goal: the node's goal is that the ascending sweep's arcs are invariant to carrier edge order with the wall fix's node set unchanged; nova/equilibrium/contour_tree.py:462 now seeds the implicit-outside birth at the wall vertex itself, and diverted-node-counts.log still reports 0 wall minima, 2 wall saddles, 6 nodes and 5 edges.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it carries status complete, the three commits, both base/head arms with their aggregate and per-file log paths, and a bare negative_control_log path, though its tests: line names one of the six gate commands rather than the six that ran.
item_verdicts.write_paths: the manifest declares seven write paths including nova/equilibrium/contour_tree.py, tests/test_contour_tree_wall_split.py and docs/evidence/fragments/contour-tree-topology-authority/split-arc-edge-order.html; git diff --stat 3baa4796e 8d4a53238 lists exactly those three and nothing else.

justifications.durability: tests/test_contour_tree_wall_split.py:193-200 asserts a literal arc set {(0, 2), (1, 2), (2, 3)} and node set [1, 2, 3] against the sweep output, and negative-inherited-birth.log shows that reinstating the inherited birth reddens this test and all three swept-arc permutation seeds, so the mutant is the regression it guards; the four-vertex fixture alone fails on both permutations of the parent revision, so the order-invariance claim itself rests on the 596-vertex arm in tests/test_contour_tree_scatter_equivalence.py:151.
justifications.evidence: the gate is the twelve per-file arms under the run directory; base-test_contour_tree_scatter_equivalence.log ends '3 failed, 4 passed' with EXIT=1 and head-test_contour_tree_scatter_equivalence.log ends '7 passed' with EXIT=0, both headers naming revision and command, though manifest.md:15 records only the scatter-equivalence command where six commands ran.
justifications.fit: the fix reuses the existing event-condition idiom two lines above it at nova/equilibrium/contour_tree.py:459 and the new test reuses the file's own _split helper, its names carry no plan label, and its fragment docs/evidence/fragments/contour-tree-topology-authority/split-arc-edge-order.html uses the section-plus-code shape of its sibling split-sweep-wall-outside.html.
justifications.goal_fidelity: nova/equilibrium/contour_tree.py:462 adds implicit_outside to the same jnp.where that already carries first_wall, so the first ascending wall visit seeds the outside birth at its own vertex, and the three seeds of the 596-vertex permutation arm move from red to green while diverted-node-counts.log keeps node_vertices [5, 10, 69, 447, 457, 461].
justifications.reuse: a capability search over nova/, tests/ and benchmarks/ for an existing order-independent component-birth mechanism found only the sweep's own births/representative machinery, which this change extends in place at nova/equilibrium/contour_tree.py:462 rather than forking; no new function, class or module is added.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat 3baa4796e 8d4a53238 touches only nova/equilibrium/contour placeholder removed -- only nova/equilibrium/contour_tree.py, tests/test_contour_tree_wall_split.py and docs/evidence/fragments/contour-tree-topology-authority/split-arc-edge-order.html, every one inside the manifest's declared write paths, and the four figure paths it was granted were left untouched.
